en.name: Narcotizer
en.ability: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned until you choose someone else. When an alive player poisoned by you becomes healthy, they learn that the Narcotizer is in play.

zh.name: 麻醉师
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择一名玩家：他中毒直到你改变选择。因你中毒的存活玩家恢复健康时，会得知麻醉师在场。
